ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light gray) macro-surface with approximately 85% coverage; low-intensity (black) pigmentation concentrated at trailing edges, lateral tips, and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark zones localized at the distal tips and along the entire trailing edge; vertical dark striations and irregular blotches clustered around the central notch extending into the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal width of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger, prominent jagged peaks (saw-tooth pattern) with amplitudes of 10-20 pixels, while the left lobe shows smaller, more rhythmic micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly convex upward curvature on the distal edges leading to sharp, tapered lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/gray calcified masses (barnacles) visible at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark vertical and diagonal rake marks; approximately 4-5 parallel vertical lines visible on the right lobe surface and diagonal marks near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on distal tips; deep irregular notch/indentation on the upper right trailing edge suggests past trauma or amputation of the fluke margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical ladder-like pigmentation pattern consisting of horizontal dark rungs centered along the vertical axis below the median notch.
